compartment.title: Re-read workers pool files for Phase 4/5 edits
compartment.p1: The agent re-read workers pool implementation files — internal/hostnet/challenge.go, internal/workers/enqueue.go, internal/workers/pool.go, internal/workers/stats.go, internal/workers/worker.go, internal/config/config_test.go, and additional unredacted files — to understand the current state before implementing Phase 4 (CDP lane) and Phase 5 (worker sizing consolidation) in the workers pool refactoring. This continues the prior pass where Phase 3 was confirmed fully converted and Phase 4/5 were identified as the next steps.
compartment.p2: Re-read workers pool files (challenge.go, enqueue.go, pool.go, stats.go, worker.go, config_test.go) to prepare for Phase 4 (CDP lane) and Phase 5 (worker sizing consolidation) edits in the ongoing workers pool refactoring.
compartment.p3: Preparatory reads for Phase 4 (CDP lane) and Phase 5 (worker sizing consolidation) in the workers pool refactoring.
